name: mailmart
description: MailMart — static Firebase app. There is no build step: the HTML files are the app.

scripts.test: node --experimental-vm-modules --test tests/policy.test.mjs tests/rewards.test.mjs tests/extended-policy.test.mjs tests/extended-rewards.test.mjs tests/installments.test.mjs tests/services.test.mjs tests/source.test.mjs
scripts.test:rules: npx --yes firebase-tools@14.22.0 emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-mailmart "node --test tests/firestore.rules.test.mjs"
